# Lotus: a pad with a pink flower, two rings of pointed petals round a yellow centre.
# Origin at the water line. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Pad --base-color 0.2353 0.6078 0.5294 --no-slot
material new Petal --base-color 0.9647 0.2039 0.4078 --no-slot
material new Heart --base-color 0.9765 0.8510 0.3333 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Pad --vertices 12 --radius 0.5 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0 0.03
material assign Pad
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cone --name P00 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.09 --radius2 0 --depth 0.3 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 0.55 1
apply --scale

apply --rotation
set location 0.170 0.000 0.12
apply --location
